reference_method: The 2011 income-statement reference and seven selected financial rows were transferred from the visually reviewed duplicate scan transcription and visually checked against this separate full-page scanned capture. No OCR/text-layer from this source was used.
limitations: One Vietnamese page from a separate archive scan capture of the same 2011 statement, not a new issuer/report/year. Reference labels originate in the existing visually transcribed duplicate statement and were checked against this capture; they are not independent double-entry labels. The PDF is hosted by CafeF, not Vinamilk. This diagnostic measures capture-to-capture OCR robustness only and cannot establish representative Vietnamese OCR quality or select a production engine.

environment.cpu_peak_scope: whole evaluator process; run one engine per invocation for engine-specific comparison
environment.child_peak_scope: maximum high-water RSS among completed child processes, where supported
